description: The line plot titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny" illustrates the performance of different configurations of the Whisper model over a series of epochs, measured by the Word Error Rate (WER). The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is linear and ranges from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled "WER," is also linear and ranges from approximately 25 to 70, with tick labels at regular intervals. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration of the Whisper model: tiny AdaLoRA_int4, tiny AdaLoRA_int8, tiny int4, tiny int8, and tiny full. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line is solid with circle markers, the tiny AdaLoRA_int8 line is dashed with square markers, the tiny int4 line is dotted with circle markers, the tiny int8 line is dash-dot with square markers, and the tiny full line is dotted with triangle markers. All lines show a general downward trend, indicating an improvement in WER as the number of epochs increases. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line starts at the highest WER value and ends at the lowest, while the tiny full line starts at the lowest WER value and ends at the highest. The other lines show varying degrees of improvement, with the tiny AdaLoRA_int8 and tiny int8 lines showing the most significant decrease in WER.
